# @scramjet/sequence-types

Sequence-author-facing types for Scramjet Transform Hub. Exports the frozen sequence AppContext API backed by BaseAppContext from @scramjet/runtime-types, plus canonical sequence application/function types for sequence authors.

## Install

```bash
npm install @scramjet/sequence-types
```

## Import

```typescript
import { /* ... */ } from "@scramjet/sequence-types";
```

## Documentation

See the [package docs](https://github.com/scramjetorg/transform-hub/tree/HEAD/packages/sequence-types) for full documentation.
